Name: Robin Sells Fiber
Author: CalculusMaster
Description:
This mod simply adds Fiber to the list of materials that Robin sells at the Carpenter's Shop.

Configuration can be tweaked to your liking in the mod's [b]content.json[/b] file, including the sell price, unlock year, and the number of Fiber in stock per day.

Thank you to the mod [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22185?tab=description]Robin Sells Hardwood[/url], which I used as a starting point for this very similar mod.

Manifest.Name: Robin Sells Fiber
Manifest.Description: Adds Fiber as a sold item in Robin's Carpenter Shop
Manifest.Author: CalculusMaster
